cases.dependencies: Reverse the lightness order of the separated colours. It does not invert each individual mask.
Maximum separated colours, from two to ten. The engine reduces images with more colours; an image with fewer colours produces fewer masks.
Remove separate regions smaller than this percentage of the whole image from each colour mask. Zero keeps them.
Physical plate width used to convert pattern spacing in millimetres to working pixels. Match the width of the stencil you will build.
Reverse lightness ranking before assigning solid paint, intermediate patterns and empty background.
Default pattern for intermediate tones. Auto lets the engine choose; darkest is solid paint and lightest is empty.
Default distance between pattern marks in millimetres. Zero turns intermediate patterned tones into solid paint; use a positive spacing for patterns.
Pattern angle in degrees. This changes lines and crosshatching where the selected pattern uses direction.
Pattern for intermediate tone 1. Auto inherits the default pattern; solid and empty explicitly replace this tone. This override is used only if that tone exists.
Spacing override for intermediate tone 1, in millimetres. Zero inherits the default spacing. Used only for a pattern with spacing.
Paint coverage override for intermediate tone 1, as a percentage. Zero uses the engine's tone-rank-based coverage; solid and empty patterns do not use coverage.

Matching registration holes in each plate margin. Zero leaves the plates unchanged and disables pins.
Diameter of each registration hole. Each plate needs a margin at least this diameter plus 1 mm.
Hole centre distance from the outside edge. Zero chooses the middle of the margin band; holes must remain inside it.
Include a real alignment pin STL with the registered plates. Requires registration holes.
Diametral clearance: subtracted from hole diameter to size the pin. Printer fit still needs physical calibration.
Length of the alignment pins in millimetres.
